slides.title: Angular's Toolbox of Pipes 🧰
slides.content:
# Commonly Used Built‑In Pipes

Angular provides a rich set of pipes. We’ll dive into:

* **DatePipe** – formats dates.
* **UpperCasePipe / LowerCasePipe** – text case.
* **CurrencyPipe** – number as currency.
* **DecimalPipe (number)** – format numbers.
* **PercentPipe** – percentage.
* **SlicePipe** – extract a slice of an array or string.
* **JsonPipe** – debug output of objects.

All are available automatically in every template.

slides.title: DatePipe – Master Time 🕰️
slides.content: Format dates with predefined or custom formats:
slides.codeSnippet:
{{ today | date }}               // 'Apr 15, 2023'
{{ today | date:'shortTime' }}    // '4:30 PM'
{{ today | date:'fullDate' }}     // 'Saturday, April 15, 2023'
{{ today | date:'dd/MM/yyyy' }}   // '15/04/2023'

slides.title: CurrencyPipe & DecimalPipe 💰
slides.content: Format numbers as currency or with specific decimal precision:
slides.codeSnippet:
{{ price | currency }}            // '$999.00' (default USD)
{{ price | currency:'EUR':'symbol' }} // '€999.00'
{{ price | currency:'JPY':'symbol':'1.0-0' }} // '¥999'

{{ pi | number:'1.2-4' }}         // '3.14' (min 1 integer, 2-4 fraction digits)
{{ pi | number:'3.5-5' }}         // '003.14159'
